result.summary: The interface exhibits a few visual inconsistencies primarily related to asset quality and placeholder graphics.

issues.description: Primary restaurant cards use low-fidelity vector illustrations instead of real food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace generic graphics with high-resolution food imagery to enhance professionalism.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké image contains red rectangular blocks that resemble unrendered placeholder assets.
issues.suggestion: Update the graphic with a complete, high-quality illustration or a realistic photo.

issues.description: Inconsistent perspective and style between different food illustrations (top-down vs. side-view).
issues.suggestion: Standardize the illustration style across all food categories for a cohesive look.
